info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v4-spec
info.description: This API is designed to manage the deletion of declined credit card applications efficiently. It provides organizations with the capability to remove specific application records that have been declined, ensuring a streamlined handling of applications. Typical consumers include financial institutions and application processing services looking to maintain up-to-date records and compliance. This operation helps in optimizing data management and maintaining data integrity within the application lifecycle.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to decline a specific application by sending a DELETE request. Upon successful execution, the application will be marked as declined and removed from the active applications list.

requestBody.description: Request body for declining an application. This action permanently removes the application from consideration.

200.description: Request completed successfully, application has been declined.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: A string representation required for the request body when declining an application through a DELETE operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the decline request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the decline operation.

state.description: The current state of the application after the decline operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the decline request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the decline operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.description: Response schema for successful application decline operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the decline request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the decline request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details regarding the audit of the decline operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
